tasks.title: FR-001 新增 Design Brief 编译层
tasks.description: 新增工件： - `design-brief.json` 至少包含： - target audience - product tone - visual direction - typography intent - palette intent - motion intent - differentiation anchor - constraints - design_generation_mode - interactive_prototype_required - guidance_anchors - design_mode_references

tasks.title: FR-002 新增 Design System Contract
tasks.description: 新增工件： - `design-system-contract.json` 至少包含： - approved font families - token palette - spacing rhythm - radius / shadow rules - motion rules - component material rules - anti-generic restrictions ### FR-002A 新增 Unified Directory + UI Style Analysis `prototype` 必须把 `index.html` 提升为正式的统一目录页 contract，而不只是生成副产物。 同时新增： - `ui-style-analysis.json` - `ui-style-analysis.md` 至少表达： - unified directory page - required page/state links - current visual system summary - secondary build required artifacts - extension rules for 二开 / agent continuation

tasks.title: FR-003 `frontend-design` 进入 generation 面
tasks.description: `prototype plan/create` 应可消费： - 结构化 requirement materials - design brief - design system contract 其职责是生成： - clear aesthetic direction - consistent visual system - non-generic page composition - description-as-design friendly prompt surface ### FR-003A 参考 GemDesign/Figma 的工作方式，但坚持 Beacon 内生生成 Beacon 不需要成为 Figma 本体，也不需要复刻 `design.gemcoder.com`。 它要借鉴的是这类系统的方法论： - 上游输入以自然语言 / user story / PRD blocks 为主 - 中间层通过 design brief + design system contract 收敛 - 下游输出是可交互、高保真、可冻结的 reference pack 但真正的原型生成执行面仍是 Beacon 内部的 LLM-driven pipeline。 也就是说，Beacon 需要明确支持： - `design_generation_mode=description-as-design` - `design_mode_references=["GemDesign-style ...", "Figma-style ..."]` - interactive prototype as a first-class Beacon delivery artifact

tasks.title: FR-004 `web-design-guidelines` 进入 review 面
tasks.description: Beacon 必须在 review 阶段拉取最新 guideline rules，并生成： - `web-guideline-review.json` - `web-guideline-review.md` 至少检查： - skip link / heading hierarchy - visible focus - reduced motion - form label / aria-label - semantic action/navigation elements - URL-reflected state - icon decoration semantics - image dimensions / loading strategy ### FR-004A Design security 进入 `review design` Beacon 参考 gstack `cso` 的思路，但不复制它的 infra-first 形态。 在 Beacon 里，软件设计安全应收敛为 `review design` 的正式子面。 至少检查： - privileged action / role boundary - upload/file constraints - secret-handling surfaces - external integration trust boundary - auditability / evidence trace

tasks.title: FR-005 Review 输出继续决策
FR-006 Bounded Autoresearch Loop
tasks.description: autoresearch 只允许优化： - page inventory expansion heuristics - state expansion heuristics - design brief extraction rules - design-system normalization rules - guideline severity mapping - review thresholds 禁止直接开放： - arbitrary page HTML self-edit - unrestricted CSS self-rewrite - full repository mutation

tasks.title: FR-007 Keep / Discard Ledger
tasks.description: 新增账本或等价记录： - `.beacon/state/eval-lab/design-keep-discard-log.jsonl` 每轮必须记录： - changed policy surface - benchmark outcome - keep/review/discard - evidence refs

tasks.title: FR-008 Freeze / Gate 需要设计真值
tasks.description: `prototype freeze` 与 gate 不应只看结构 review pass，还必须看： - web guideline critical findings 是否为 0 - design review outcome 是否允许放行 - design-system contract 是否与生成物一致 - description-as-design / interactive prototype contract 是否被保留到冻结态

tasks.title: FR-009 单一版本真相源
tasks.description: Beacon 必须引入 machine-readable version truth source，至少同时表达： - current package/runtime line - current accepted docs line - active planning line - line closure status (`planning` / `partial-runtime-facts` / `runtime-closed`) 要求： - `SKILL.md` - runtime version export - help/status payload - release docs - docs current-line resolver 都必须从同一 truth source 派生，而不是各自维护描述。

tasks.title: FR-010 navigator 必须 profile-aware first
tasks.description: help / doctor / status 在推荐 implement / verify / review / gate 前，必须先解析： - version truth - project mode (`greenfield` / `takeover` / `project-profiled`) - feature/profile binding - stage-local execution surface - profile gate result 只有缺少 binding 时，才能降级到 Beacon native 通用路径。

tasks.title: FR-011 Project Execution Adapter Capability Boundary
tasks.description: project skill orchestration 在运行前必须显式校验： - `supported_stages` - `capabilities` - `requires_env` - `evidence_contract` - required evidence / required cases alignment 若 node 声明与 skill registry 不一致，系统应： - blocked - record reason code - refuse execution 不得把 profile node 直接当成任意 shell command surface。

tasks.title: FR-012 Typed Learning Plane Surfaces
tasks.description: learning plane 至少拆分为以下 typed mutation surfaces： - `qa_policy` - `design_policy` - `contract_policy` - `debug_policy` - `rewrite_policy` - `benchmark_policy` `v1.1.12` 的 design governance 相关 surface 至少应包含： - design brief extraction rules - design-system normalization rules - guideline severity mapping - review thresholds - contract drift rules 禁止将以下内容纳入 trainable subject surface： - project execution command templates - gateway / UAT / pipeline commands - secrets / cookies / storage state - arbitrary repo implementation code

tasks.title: FR-013 Takeover Baseline Runtime Gate
tasks.description: 当 project mode=`takeover` 时，进入 implement 之前必须验证： - `execution/architecture-blueprint.md` - `execution/current-state-service-map.md` - `execution/refactor-boundaries.md` - current baseline freeze 任一缺失都必须 blocked，并返回 takeover-specific next action。

tasks.title: FR-014 Project Docs 只作为只读 Contract Inputs
tasks.description: project-specific boundary / service-slice / QA evolution materials 可以进入： - profile gate - contract drift detection - verify/review/gate inputs 但不得自动升格为： - Beacon core 默认执行动作 - learning plane trainable execution surface - 通用 native runner 的替代实现 ## 6. Suggested Artifact Model ```text docs/beacon/<version>/prototype/<feature>/ prototype-plan.json design-brief.json design-system-contract.json theme.json tokens.css web-guideline-review.json web-guideline-review.md prototype-review.json pages/ states/ .beacon/state/version-truth/ current.json .beacon/state/profile-routing/ <feature>.json .beacon/state/takeover-gates/ <feature>.json ``` ## 7. Review/Gate Truth Model Prototype design governance 至少要回答： 1. 设计方向是否被明确编译 2. 页面是否消费共享设计系统 3. 页面是否落入 generic-style anti-pattern 4. guideline failures 是否存在高严重度阻断项 5. 哪些 finding 必须回流到下一轮 iteration 6. 当前版本真相是否单源且无歧义 7. 当前任务是否被路由到正确 project execution surface 8. learning plane 是否只改 typed judgement surfaces 9. takeover baseline 是否已冻结 ## 8. Success Standard 这条线完成时，Beacon 应能稳定做到： - 在生成前说明将采用的设计方向 - 在生成后说明页面是否遵循共享 design system - 在评审后说明哪些 guideline finding 阻断 release - 在下一轮中把这些 finding 回流到 bounded autoresearch 面 - 在执行前说明为什么当前任务走 Beacon native 或 project adapter - 在任何时候说明当前 planning line / runtime line / docs line 的真实关系
